# GENERATED BY generate_combat_files.py — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
#
# pod_combat_ai_csv_select_effect is the sole AI move picker for all
# combats (1v1 and NvN alike). It reuses the standard player move
# effects (pod_combat_use_{key}_effect), which work for any actor
# because the workspace bridge loads the current actor into
# pod_combat_player_* and their target into pod_combat_opponent_*.
#
# Trait gates check var:pod_combat_actor_char, which is set in
# pod_combat_load_actor_from_slot_effect.

				var:pod_combat_player_energy_used >= 3
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.75
				has_variable = pod_combat_player_energy_used
				var:pod_combat_player_energy_used >= 4
			}
			pod_combat_use_shintai_of_smoke_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = pod_combat_ai_last_move value = flag:shintai_of_smoke }
		}
